scenes.name: last-pool
scenes.prompt: An immense ivory nautilus shell lies half buried in a vast cracked terracotta desert beneath an ink-blue dusk sky. The shell is a sculpted vessel tilted toward us, its open chamber containing the last pool of luminous turquoise water. A small vermilion wooden boat rests on this pool, carrying a single round glowing pearl in its hull. A narrow silver-blue stream escapes the shell toward the lower right and winds far across the dry landscape. On the distant horizon stands one enormous closed ivory flower bud. The shell occupies the left half, the red boat is clearly readable near the middle, and the right half opens into spacious desert and twilight. An exquisite surrealist oil painting with dimensional carved ivory, jewel-colored enamel, deep velvet shadows, warm copper earth, delicate engraved textures and precise luminous highlights. Monumental distinct silhouettes, tactile detail, poetic dream logic and generous negative space.

prompt_schedule.name: the-reflection
prompt_schedule.prompt: A vermilion boat carrying a golden flowering tree rooted in a luminous pearl floats on calm turquoise water. Below its hull the reflected tree extends deep into transparent water, its fine golden branches becoming luminous roots. Ivory cliffs and a warm pale sky remain above the horizon. The water beneath the boat opens into visible depth. An exquisite dimensional surrealist oil painting, deep ultramarine and luminous turquoise, pearlescent ivory, warm copper and a small vermilion accent. Tactile carved surfaces, crisp engraved detail, luminous reflected light and deep velvet shadows. Monumental readable silhouettes, generous open space and poetic dream logic.

prompt_schedule.name: beneath-the-gift
prompt_schedule.prompt: A red boat and its golden tree are seen near the upper edge through a transparent turquoise water surface. Below the glowing pearl, golden roots descend into a deep blue submerged world. The roots curl around a single luminous ivory arch in the lower middle. Sunbeams enter the water diagonally, and the space between roots is dark and spacious. An exquisite dimensional surrealist oil painting, deep ultramarine and luminous turquoise, pearlescent ivory, warm copper and a small vermilion accent. prompt_schedule.prompt: Below a turquoise sea, golden tree roots curve into elegant ivory arches of a submerged city. One pearl glows at the center of a broad arched entrance, while a faint red boat silhouette is visible far above through the bright water surface. Wide dark-blue spaces separate graceful carved columns and coral-colored stone. Warm lights glow in a few tiny windows. Tall thin towers surround generous open water, a tiny red boat-shaped sculpture rests on a bridge. Deep blue shadows make each structure dimensional.
